title: Плани UAC-0133 (Sandworm) щодо кібердиверсії на майже 20 об'єктах критичної інфраструктури України

entities.name: Sandworm
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage and sabotage group attributed to the GRU, also tracked as UAC-0002 and APT44.

entities.name: UAC-0133
entities.gloss: A threat activity cluster and sub-cluster of Sandworm targeting Ukrainian water supply facilities.

entities.name: Ukraine
entities.gloss: A sovereign country in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: QUEUESEED
entities.gloss: A C++ backdoor malware family also known as KNUCKLETOUCH, ICYWELL, WRONGSENS, and KAPEKA.

entities.name: LOADGRIP
entities.gloss: A C-based ELF payload injector that decrypts and injects malicious code using the Linux ptrace API.

entities.name: BIASBOAT
entities.gloss: A C-based ELF backdoor designed for Linux systems, serving as the Linux variant of QUEUESEED.

entities.name: WEEVELY
entities.gloss: A weaponized PHP web shell designed for post-exploitation and remote command execution.

entities.name: REGEORG.NEO
entities.gloss: A web-based proxy and tunneling tool used to pivot network traffic through compromised web servers.

entities.name: PIVOTNACCI
entities.gloss: A tunneling and pivot tool used to establish persistence and route traffic within compromised corporate networks.

entities.name: GOSSIPFLOW
entities.gloss: A Go-based malicious tool that provides network tunneling via Yamux and functions as a SOCKS5 proxy.

entities.name: SDELETE
entities.gloss: A command-line utility from Microsoft Sysinternals used to securely delete files.

entities.name: CHISEL
entities.gloss: An open-source TCP and UDP tunneling tool written in Go.

entities.name: LIBPROCESSHIDER
entities.gloss: A Linux utility utilizing ld.so.preload to hide specific processes under Linux.

entities.name: JUICYPOTATONG
entities.gloss: A Windows privilege escalation tool based on the Potato family of exploits.

entities.name: ROTTENPOTATONG
entities.gloss: A local privilege escalation tool exploiting Windows token manipulation.

entities.name: Linux
entities.gloss: An open-source Unix-like operating system family.

entities.name: Windows
entities.gloss: A proprietary graphical operating system developed by Microsoft.
